name: swarm-manager.archive-terminal
purpose: Preview or archive at most 50 explicitly reviewed completed/dropped backlog snapshots while preserving their verdicts, evidence and independent authorization receipts.

items.description: Explicit kind/name targets with expected_status (completed or dropped) and expected_updated from current owner reads.

assumptions: Swarm Manager is running and the caller has verified bookkeeping authority for each exact object.
The caller separately supplies the exact destructive binding grant; declaration and preview confer no authority.
The caller reviewed current owner records and treats partial receipts and lost observations as unresolved.
invariants: Only caller-supplied terminal snapshots are addressed; no implicit inventory scan or target widening.
Preview is the default and performs no domain mutation.
Existing terminal verdicts, dependency references and evidence remain unchanged.
The owner rechecks object authorization, current state and active work/review; a changed or refused target is skipped.
No retry or advisory agent is spawned; every path reports one bounded envelope.

signals.selected: Number of explicit reviewed targets, at most 50.
signals.executed: Whether execution was requested; not a claim every target changed.
signals.eligible: Number of eligible preview targets or successful archives.
signals.archived: Number of records actually archived by this call.
signals.skipped: Number refused, changed, unavailable, missing or already archived.
signals.codes: Distribution of authoritative per-item receipt codes.
signals.examples: At most five per-item receipts; the owner retains full history.

outputs.evidence: Explicit backlog references; authoritative mutation events retain actor, grant and independent approver.
